_what: Every pathway of reactive nitrogen to Danish marine waters we could enumerate. lo/hi are plausible bounds in kt N/yr; null means not quantified. The empty rows are the point: with the set unclosed there is no denominator and no percentages.
_bounds_are_ours: Bounds marked own:true are constructed here, not published figures.
